tools.name: loShuGrid
tools.description: Takes a birth date (dob, YYYY-MM-DD) and returns the filled 3x3 Lo Shu grid with present, missing and repeated numbers, completed planes, the arithmetic trail and a short reading. Example input: {"dob":"1990-05-14"}

tools.name: lifePath
tools.description: Takes a birth date (dob, YYYY-MM-DD) and returns the life path number (masters 11, 22, 33 kept) with its trail, plus mulank and bhagyank. Example input: {"dob":"1990-05-14"}

tools.name: nameNumber
tools.description: Takes a name in Latin letters (name) and returns its Chaldean destiny number, compound number and the per-letter trail. Example input: {"name":"Chloé"}

tools.name: compatibility
tools.description: Takes two birth dates (dobA, dobB, YYYY-MM-DD) and returns a 0 to 100 harmony score, a label and the reasons from life path and mulank. Example input: {"dobA":"1990-05-14","dobB":"1992-11-03"}
